source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeApexPagesStandardSetControllerEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Account first = new Account(Name = 'First'); Account second = new Account(Name = 'Second'); insert new List<Account>{first, second}; ApexPages.StandardSetController controller = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(new List<Account>{first, second}); System.assertEquals(2, controller.getResultSize()); System.assertEquals(first, controller.getRecord()); System.assertEquals(0, controller.getListViewOptions().size()); System.assertEquals(true, controller.getCompleteResult()); controller.setFilterID('00B000000000001'); System.assertEquals('00B000000000001', controller.getFilterId()); controller.setPageSize(1); System.assertEquals(1, controller.getPageSize()); controller.setpageNumber(2); System.assertEquals(second, controller.getRecord()); controller.previous(); System.assertEquals(first, controller.getRecord()); controller.last(); System.assertEquals(second, controller.getRecord()); controller.first(); System.assertEquals(first, controller.getRecord()); List<SObject> selected = new List<SObject>{second}; controller.setSelected(selected); System.assertEquals(1, controller.getSelected().size()); PageReference cancelled = controller.cancel(); System.assertEquals('', cancelled.getUrl()); first.Name = 'First Saved'; PageReference saved = controller.save(); System.assertEquals('', saved.getUrl()); } }
